title.mood: nostalgic, hopeful; solo piano then flute over harp and strings
title.use: Main menu / title screen. Introduces the main motif. Play once, then silence.

morning.mood: light, airy, dawn in tall grass; flowing piano and flute (G major, lydian colour)
morning.use: Exploration at dawn / early morning. Play once, then minutes of silence.

afternoon.mood: warm village waltz (3/4); nylon guitar & harp, violin and flute
afternoon.use: Afternoon in or near the village. Play once, then silence.

dusk.mood: golden hour, bittersweet; swelling strings and piano (F major, borrowed bVI/iv)
dusk.use: Sunset / golden hour by the lake. Play once, then silence.

night.mood: starry night; sparse slow piano, soft pad, celesta stars (E lydian)
night.use: Night exploration under the stars. Very sparse; play once, then silence.

ruins.mood: mystery and wonder; solo cello, low piano, distant horn (D dorian), lots of space
ruins.use: Approaching the ancient ruins / stone giants. Play once, then silence.

memory.mood: magical memory / vision; shimmering harp, celesta motif, airy pad (Eb lydian)
memory.use: Stinger for visions / memories of the vanished people. Ends softly.

discover.mood: short discovery stinger; harp glissando, soft chord, motif head on celesta
discover.use: Finding a relic / point of interest / journal entry.

finale.mood: meteor-shower ending; the main motif in full, strings+piano+flute+horn, warm climax, quiet resolution
finale.use: Ending / meteor shower sequence and credits. Play once.

village_night.mood: lullaby by the village fire; music box and nylon guitar (G major)
village_night.use: Near the village campfire at night. Seamless loop (tail folded into the start); fade in/out in game.
